newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:
Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Antonio Cavaco Servinho had been nominated as DGXIV new Director General.

Vale de Almeida said Commission President Jacques Santer had announced at the European Parliament that he would make concrete proposals at the Amsterdam European Council to complete the internal market by January 1, 1999.

Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said the Russian authorities had adopted legislation on Tuesday imposing new taxes at Russian borders for incoming and outgoing persons and vehicles. He said the Commission would take diplomatic initiatives in Moscow to express its concern and ask for clarifications.

Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori briefed on Thursday and Friday's Transport Council. He said the main point on the agenda was the relations with Switzerland. He said discussions would also focus on conditions for admitting non-resident road passenger carriers, on transport of hazardous or polluting goods and on security rules for fishing boats.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1149: Commission supports urban renewal in Malmo with ECU 5 million.
- IP/96/1153: Commission initiates proceedings on loans granted for the continued operation and restructuring of the MTW-Schiffswerft and Volkswerft Stralsund yards.
- IP/96/1154: Commissioner van den Broek is deeply concerned about new Russian border charges.
- IP/96/1158: Commission to provide ECU 2.7 million for the city of Halle.
- IP/96/1162: Single market - Commission publishes book on its impact and effectiveness.
- IP/96/1163: EU/Palestine: ECU 20 million to finance education costs.
- IP/96/1164: EU/Palestine: Initialling of a Euro-Mediterranean interim association agreement on trade and cooperation.
- Speech/96/327: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer on the Dublin European Council.
- Memo/96/119: Community assistance to the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
- Europe - "The Single Market and Tomorrow's Europe" - progress report.
